تستغرقين (form X)
# تَسْتَغْرِقِينَ (tastaḡriqīna) /tas.taɣ.ri.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
# تُسْتَغْرَقِينَ (tustaḡraqīna) /tus.taɣ.ra.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
